summary: Full backend + frontend testing of the new standalone Method Statement tool. Backend template CRUD, validation (empty name/steps -> 400), soft delete, and unauthorized access all pass. /api/documents/save with toolId='method-statement' + real jobId correctly emits 'method_statement_created' event on /api/jobs/{id}/events. Frontend wizard: all 12 steps rendered with correct data-testid, stepper navigation works, Step 1 fields pre-fill (preparedBy='Darren Morris', revisionNumber='Rev 1'), Step 3 add/duplicate/delete/drag-handle work, template save modal POSTs to /api/method-statement/templates (200) and picker appears, Step 4/5 tables (plant/materials) work, Step 6 PPE 8 cards + other-text present with default 4 selected in state, Step 7/8/9/10 all fields/groups present, Step 11 preview renders iframe, Step 12 Generate triggers POST /api/documents/save returning 200 with no toast errors. Tools Library integration: H&S category shows Method Statement card, click navigates to /app/method-statement, Site Diary moved into H&S, previously listed removed cards are absent, 6 categories preserved. Regression routes /app/rams, /app/tools-library, /app/finance, /app/business, /app/compliance, /app/settings all render.

design_issues.screen: Any page containing a project link dropdown (MethodStatement Step 1)
issues: React hydration warning: <span data-ve-dynamic> is being rendered as a child of <option> in the project-link <select>. This is a low-priority DOM validity warning (doesn't break functionality) but pollutes the console. Source appears to be a build-time instrumentation wrapper (x-ve-dynamic attributes), not user code. Can be ignored if this instrumentation is intentional.

critical_code_review_comments: method_statement.py backend module is clean: uses UUID ids, excludes _id, soft-delete pattern, proper 400/404 error codes, pydantic validation, user-scoped queries.
server.py kind_map correctly registers 'method-statement' -> 'method_statement_created' for project timeline event emission.
MethodStatement.jsx is 825 lines — consider splitting the 12 Step components into separate files under /pages/methodStatement/ to stay under the ~700-line guideline. Not a functional issue.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all specified data-testid selectors present, all interactions and API integrations verified)

seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up TEST_MS_Template_1 template, TEST_MS Document, TEST_MS with job (job auto-deleted), and TEST_UI_Template (still in DB via UI test). Templates are user-scoped and soft-deleted so this has no cross-user impact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL: https://prompt-web-4.preview.emergentagent.com. Method Statement tool at /app/method-statement is fully functional end-to-end. Backend pytest lives at /app/backend/tests/test_method_statement.py. Only minor console noise is a pre-existing hydration warning about <span> inside <option> caused by a build-time instrumentation wrapper (data-ve-dynamic) — appears on any page using <select><option>{expr}</option></select> and is not specific to Method Statement.
